divergence_deg.source_ref: golden-angle spiral, generic for spiral phyllotaxis; NOT a Micro-Tom measurement - used only to flag azimuth-order inconsistencies, never to place a leaf

single_angle_max_bend_deg.source_ref: Claude Code 2026-10-14: above this base-half vs tip-half elevation difference the compound is corrected per segment (alpha definition), not with one angle

min_side_dx_fraction.source_ref: Claude Code 2026-10-14: a side view resolves a compound's elevation only if its horizontal extent across the view is at least this fraction of its top-view length

blade_curvature.source_ref: leaflet blade curvature deferred (O7); every output says so

overlap_success_rel_error.source_ref: Itakura & Hosoi 2018 success criterion (area error < 10 %), a candidate per the prompt

slot_max_background_frac.source_ref: E2 gate (Claude Code 2026-10-14): a hidden slot is created only if at most this share of its expected footprint (mirrored partner mask, or the tip disk) shows observed BACKGROUND; more -> the leaflet would be visible there, so it is absent / not created

slot_min_covered_frac.source_ref: E2 gate: and at least this share of the footprint is covered by another observed leaf (positive evidence of an occluder); weaker evidence -> not created

cut_evidence_frac.source_ref: E2 gate: a visible leaflet counts as cut when the occluder pixels inside its convex hull reach this share of its visible area; the per-sample cut probability is evidence / (2 x this), clipped to [0, 1]

terminal_probe_radius_rel.source_ref: E2: expected terminal footprint = disk of this x compound top length at the axis tip

blade_curvature_max_deg.source_ref: Claude Code proposal 2026-10-14 (provisional): per sample, roll and bend arcs of a leaflet blade drawn uniformly in [0, max]; area factor = g(roll) x g(bend), g(phi) = (phi/2) / sin(phi/2) - expresses the flat-blade assumption (O7) as an uncertainty, not a correction of the point estimate

elevation_sd_source.source_ref: per half: robust sd of the side-view pixel heights the elevation was read from (E3), propagated; not calibrated on the test truth
